evidence: Cleared on entering the join password menu, typed into by its update, drawn as "Session Password: %s" and passed to Network_JoinEnumeratedSession as the session's password.
FrontendMenu_UpdateJoinPasswordEntry points it at g_unk0x00818da8 and copies the edited text back through it.
FrontendMenu_UpdateNetworkSessionDetails points it at g_sessionName or g_sessionPassword, by the item under the cursor, and copies the edited text back through it.
The name typed in OptionMenu_UpdateLoadGameAndNameEntry; SavedGames_WriteSessionImage(-1, it) saves under it and it is cleared after.
Set when the lobby's cursor is on its chat line (item value 0), which then takes typed characters and turns off menu navigation; cleared when the cursor leaves it or with Escape.
The lobby's chat line: typed characters are appended, Backspace deletes, Enter sends it with NetworkChat_SendLine and clears it.
Characters in g_unk0x00818f14: its index for the next character, incremented and decremented with it, reset when it is sent or selected.
FrontendMenu_UpdateNetworkSessionSetup compares the lobby's cursor with it to notice moves onto or off the chat line, then stores the cursor.
GameMenu_HandleNetworkResultsChatInput compares the menu's cursor with it to notice moves onto or off the chat item (0x3eb), then stores the cursor; -1 when the menu is built.
StageObject_QueueTimedEventDraw stores a draw at g_eventDraws[it] and increments it (up to 0x40); StageObject_StampPendingEventDraws stamps that many and clears it.
StageObject_StampPendingEventDraws advances it 0..3 and locks that quadrant of the event texture.
Frontend_SelectTextLanguage sets it (with m_textFirstId = m_textCount * language) when the language is below the count.
BuildLocalizedTextStringTable sets it to the number of language files; Frontend_SelectTextLanguage accepts languages below it.
FrontendMenu_DrawLanguage draws g_matrixMaps[it[cursor]] for the language menu's entries: 10 (UK), 2 (France), 9 (Spain), 6 (Italy), 8 (Germany).
